name: io.github.sepehr071/ifb-mcp
title: Iran Fara Bourse
description: Read-only Iran Fara Bourse (ifb.ir): bond, sukuk and treasury yields, IPOs, notices, market stats.

environmentVariables.name: IFB_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the ifb.ir requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
